# CrUX History fixtures

Hand-built from the documented response shape of `records:queryHistoryRecord` (https://developer.chrome.com/docs/crux/history-api, accessed 2026-10-13): 25 weekly periods, a `null` p75 where data is missing, `"NaN"` histogram densities, and CLS p75 values as strings. Origin `https://example.com` only. No real data.
